# `omapac missing`

- **Usage:** `omapac missing <PACKAGES>…`

Exit 0 when none of the named packages is installed, else 1

The complement of `present`, with the same matching rules.

## Arguments
- **`<PACKAGES>…`** — Package names, optionally with a version constraint

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
